steps: Explored the target application at the root URL, found a search form at /?search=
Probed HTML tags to identify which are whitelisted: svg, a, animate, text, image, title, circle, rect, line
Confirmed all event handlers (onclick, onmouseover, etc.) are blocked
Confirmed href attributes are blocked on static elements
Discovered that <animate attributeName=href values=javascript:alert(1)> bypasses the href block by dynamically setting href via SVG animation
Crafted payload:
Delivered payload via search parameter and clicked the SVG text element in browser
evidence: Browser confirmed 'is-solved' class in page HTML after clicking the SVG animate XSS vector. Subsequent HTTP GET to homepage confirmed 'is-solved' status.
comments: The WAF blocks event handlers and href attributes on static HTML, but the SVG <animate> element can dynamically set the href attribute on an <a> element to a javascript: URI, bypassing the filter. When the user clicks the animated link, the javascript: URI executes alert(1).
